summary: Extends BGP to carry Autonomous System numbers as four-octet values instead of the two-octet encoding in the base specification. It obsoletes RFC 4893 and updates RFC 4271. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: The internet gave each network a number, but the original number size was running out. This memo makes the numbers longer so there are many more to give out.

questions: what is a four-octet as number
